🎓 How to Use the Content Layer Audit Skill

Use this skill in Joule to automate content classification and get AI-powered curation recommendations.

💬

Trigger Phrases

Say any of these to Joule:

  • "Audit my content portfolio"
  • "Classify content by layer"
  • "What content should I automate?"
  • "Content curation analysis"
  • "Commodity vs signature content"
📝

Sample Prompt

Try this in Joule:

"Audit my SAP S/4HANA content portfolio. I have 15 blog posts, 5 whitepapers, 8 sales decks, and 3 customer videos. Classify each into Commodity, Strategic, or Signature layers and recommend what to automate."
📊

What You'll Get

  • Layer Classification — Each asset sorted by strategic value
  • Automation Candidates — Commodity content to AI-generate
  • Investment Priorities — Where human creativity matters most
  • Gap Analysis — Missing content types by layer
💡

Pro Tips

  • Include metrics — Engagement, conversions, time on page
  • Note competitors — "Competitors all have this = Commodity"
  • Consider audience — Exec content often = Signature
  • Ask for gaps — "What Signature content am I missing?"
